verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service platform with an operations console, so built-in operational AI is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only a centralized ops workflow platform, KYC/EDD and webhooks. It shows no natural-language transaction search, AI-drafted dispute or alert responses, or anomaly summaries. The llms.txt probe only shows documentation formatted for LLMs, not AI built into the product.

support.subject: As an ops user, the product ships its own AI for banking operations — natural-language search over transactions, drafted responses to disputes and alerts, anomaly summaries — built in, not bolted on
